status_as_of_cutoff: Kuna’s official records document the Planning and Zoning Commission recommendation and a City Council 3–2 approval of the comprehensive-plan amendment and rezone, plus a police-contribution MOU. The approval is an entitlement step, not proof of building permits, construction, power allocation, or operation; local reporting says no infrastructure or facilities had broken ground by the reviewed cutoff.
